Theme

Latin word

quaestus

quaestus, quaestūs m.

noun, fourth declension

a living, paid work, a way of earning; a line of business, a trade; job, livelihood, way of earning; gain, earnings; a living, a way of making money

In this lexicon

  • employment

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Rud. 2.1.2: pauperēs hominēs, quibus nec quaestus est (Lewis & Short); Traupman 309: employment (occupation), quaestus; Traupman 309

  • industry

    also used · classical · Cic. Off. 1.150: dē artificiīs et quaestibus

  • job

    also used · classical · Traupman 335

  • profit

    also used · classical · Publ. N 5: nūllus est tam tūtus quaestus, quam quod habeās parcere

  • trade

    also used · classical · M-O s.v. work, job: quō quaestū tē tenēs?, what do you do for a living?; Traupman 309
